headerDisplay: Bridges TELETASK DoIP devices into HomeKit. Requires an active TDS15132 (DoIP Open Protocol) license on your central unit — see the plugin README.

port.title: Port
port.description: DoIP Open Protocol port. Leave at 55957 unless you changed it in PROSOFT.

centralUnit.title: Default central unit
centralUnit.description: Central unit index (1 = 'A'). Can be overridden per accessory.

autoDiscover.title: Auto-discover outputs on startup
autoDiscover.description: On by default: probe the unit at startup and append any newly-found outputs to the config (with generic names). Set "visible": false on any you want to ignore. Set this to false to disable discovery entirely. Adds a few seconds to startup.

outputId.title: Output / function number
outputId.description: The output number from PROSOFT (GUISOFT > Define Output). (The old key "number" is still accepted.)

visible.title: Visible in HomeKit
visible.description: Set to false to keep this entry in the config but NOT expose it in HomeKit (useful for ignoring auto-discovered outputs you don't want).

centralUnit.title: Central unit (optional)
centralUnit.description: Overrides the default central unit for this accessory.

invertPosition.title: Invert blind position
invertPosition.description: Blinds only: flip if HomeKit open/closed is reversed.

climate.title: Climate mode (thermostats only)
climate.description: For thermostat/heating accessories: limits HomeKit to the modes the zone supports.

temperatureFrom.title: Borrow temperature from zone (thermostats only)
temperatureFrom.description: For a zone with no temperature of its own (e.g. AC): sensor-zone number to read the current temperature from instead.

powerRelay.title: On/off via relay (thermostats & dimmers)
powerRelay.description: Relay output number to use for on/off — for a thermostat (underfloor circuit) or a dimmer that needs a relay to fully switch off.

minBrightness.title: Dimmer: level for HomeKit 1% (lowest usable)
minBrightness.description: Dimmers only: the Teletask level (0-100) the light reaches at HomeKit 1%. Maps the slider's low end to the light's real floor.

maxBrightness.title: Dimmer: level for HomeKit 100% (full)
maxBrightness.description: Dimmers only: the Teletask level (0-100) that gives full brightness (e.g. 75 if the light stops getting brighter above 75%).
